title: Is Your LLM-as-a-Recommender Agent Trustable? LLMs’ Recommendation is Easily Hacked by Biases (Preferences)

bias_targets.target: Cognitive and Context-Relevant Biases (Authority, Bandwagon, Marketing, Urgency, Brand, SOTA)
bias_targets.methodology: Using a Bias Synthesis Pipeline to strictly control the quality gap between optimal and sub-optimal options, then injecting counterfeit contextual triggers (e.g., fake endorsements, popularity metrics, promotional cues) into the sub-optimal options to measure if the LLM-as-a-Recommender incorrectly prioritizes these heuristic cues over objective quality.

bias_targets.target: Structural and Context-Agnostic Biases (Position, Verbosity, Instruction, Distraction)
bias_targets.methodology: Manipulating the presentation or formatting of sub-optimal options within a candidate pool—such as changing their index position, artificially inflating text length (verbosity), adding adversarial system instructions, or appending irrelevant noise—to evaluate the model's robustness and accuracy degradation.
